links.outcome: Deployed agentic RAG assistant scored on rubric-based HealthBench Hard clinical competencies vs frontier LLMs
links.effect: DR. INFO scored 0.68 on HealthBench Hard vs GPT-5 0.46, GPT-5.2 0.42, GPT-5.1 0.40, Grok 3 0.23, Gemini 2.5 Pro 0.19, Claude 3.7 Sonnet 0.02; 0.72 in a 100-sample comparison against OpenEvidence and Pathway.md.
links.quote: On the Hard subset of 1,000 challenging examples, DR. INFO achieves a HealthBench Hard score of 0.68, outperforming leading frontier LLMs including the GPT-5 model family (GPT-5: 0.46, GPT-5.2: 0.42, GPT-5.1: 0.40), Grok 3 (0.23), Gemini 2.5 Pro (0.19), and Claude 3.7 Sonnet (0.02) across all behavioral axes (accuracy, completeness, instruction following, etc.).

screen.reason: Evaluates a proprietary agentic RAG-based clinical assistant (DR. INFO) and other LLMs against a benchmark dataset of realistic clinical queries (HealthBench).
